description.value:
Choose the patron of your oath from Dao, Djinni, Efreeti, or Marid. Whenever you use Divine Smite, you can invoke the effect corresponding to your patron.

  • Dao's Crush. The target has to make a Strength Saving Throw or be Restrained for 1 minute. On its turn, the target can make a Strength check against your Spell Save DC to end the effect.
  • Djinni's Escape. You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of yourself and take on a mist-like form, which lasts until the end of your next turn. While in this form, you have Immunity to the Grappled, Prone, and Restrained conditions.
  • Efreeti's Fury. The target takes additional fire damage equal to a number of D8s x 1/2 your Proficiency (rounded down). Any die size increment to your Divine Smite also affects this feature. The target is then set ablaze for 1 minute. While under this effect, the target takes fire damage equal to 2 x your Proficiency at the start of each of its turns. At the end of any of its turns, it can make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC to end the effect.
  • Marid's Surge. The target and each creature of your choice in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Strength Saving Throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 15 feet straight away from you and has the Prone condition.
